key_insight: Agentar-Fin-OCR converts ultra-long, complex financial PDFs into semantically consistent, audited structured outputs by restoring cross-page continuity and enabling cell-level references, yielding high accuracy suitable for regulated finance workflows.
problem_solved: Addresses finance-specific document parsing challenges: complex multi-column and table layouts, structural discontinuities across pages, loss of cell-level relationships, and the need for audit-grade provenance in extraction results.
method: Cross-page Contents Consolidation: algorithmically stitch and restore logical continuity of fragmented elements (tables, captions, footnotes) that span pages.
Layout-aware OCR + table reconstruction: combine spatial/layout features with text recognition to recover table cells and explicit cell-level references and relationships.
Provenance & validation layer: emit structured outputs with precise source pointers (page/coordinate), confidence scores, and audit traces for downstream verification.
impact: Makes extraction from long, heterogeneous financial documents reliable and auditable, reducing manual cleanup and enabling safer downstream ML/analytics, compliance checks, and model training on high-quality structured data.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart: raw PDF → layout-aware OCR → cross-page consolidation → table/cell reconstruction → audited structured output
Before/after example: a table split across pages (raw) vs. a consolidated, labeled table (output)
Diagram of cell-level referencing: arrows linking extracted cell values to original page coordinates and provenance badges
Bar chart or table of benefits: accuracy gains, reduced manual correction time, and provenance coverage
paper_authors: Siyi Qian, Xiongfei Bai, Bingtao Fu, Yichen Lu, Gaoyang Zhang
